tasks.brief:
# Cambio project priority discovery (planner 2026-08-11)

## Source of truth
- Linear doc: https://linear.app/ebrierton-cambio/document/project-priority-order-67a9122bb396
- Repo: https://github.com/evanbrierton/cambio
- Prod: https://cambio.brierton.ie
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + PartyKit/Cloudflare DO (`party/cambio.ts`) + Vitest + Biome

## Recommended order
1. **Game polish** — critical engine/UI bugs + safe library adoption
2. **Offline P2P Phase 0** — CAM-19 GameHost + CAM-20 useServerMessages + CAM-21 tests (NO LAN/WebRTC)
3. **Matchmaking v1** — CAM-50 epic on thin CambioParty
4. **Tutorial** — CAM-65 after home/lobby stable
5. **Mobile Phase 0–1** — adapters + packages/game + packages/client
6. **Defer** — Offline LAN/WebRTC (CAM-22+), native shells (CAM-41+), framer-heavy juice (CAM-17), settings page (CAM-55)

## Phase 1 — Game polish status (main as of 2026-08-11)
### Done (do not reopen)
CAM-80 children merged: CAM-82 zustand, CAM-81 cookies-next, CAM-83 next-themes, CAM-84 lucide, CAM-85 zod, CAM-64 card points, CAM-75 swap VFX, CAM-87 private-card chat, CAM-76/77 ability bugs, most critical gameplay bugs.

### Remaining in phase 1
- **CAM-88** (Todo, S): Route bot chat LLM through Vercel AI Gateway — `src/game/bot-chat-llm.ts`, `party/cambio.ts`, `party/env.d.ts`. Workers-compatible `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, NOT Vercel OIDC. Keep template fallback. Still calls `api.groq.com` today.

### Deferred polish
CAM-17 juice (XL, framer lock-in), CAM-55 settings page, CAM-57 theme IA, CAM-56 auth prefs, CAM-86 i18n spike.

## Phase 2 — Offline P2P Phase 0 (after polish)
Issues: CAM-19 (XL) extract GameHost from `party/cambio.ts`; CAM-20 (M) extract `useServerMessages` from `useGameConnection`; CAM-21 (L) GameHost unit tests + online smoke checklist.
Key paths: `party/cambio.ts` (~fat DO), `src/game/engine.ts`, `src/hooks/useGameConnection.ts`, `src/game/wire-schema.ts`.
Goal: CambioParty becomes thin transport adapter; GameHost owns room lifecycle, handleMessage, views, alarms, bots, persistence.
Do NOT build CAM-22 LAN, CAM-23 useP2PConnection, CAM-26 WebRTC in this phase.

## Phase 3 — Matchmaking v1 (after GameHost)
Epic CAM-50. Core issues: CAM-51 MatchmakingParty DO, CAM-52 auto-start + bot fill, CAM-54 lobby status UI, home Find Match CTA.
Design doc: https://linear.app/ebrierton-cambio/document/matchmaking-v1-design-43b3ec2d1df6
Defer P2: CAM-61 rematch, CAM-59 regional, CAM-62 bot difficulty on matchmaking screen.

## Phase 4 — Tutorial (after matchmaking)
Epic CAM-65. Sub-issues CAM-66 persistence, CAM-67 react-joyride coach, CAM-68 landing modal, CAM-69 rules page, CAM-71 polish.
DOM-only react-joyride is fine for Capacitor-first; targets home + GameTable — needs stable lobby CTAs first.

## Phase 5 — Mobile Phase 0–1 (after tutorial)
Epic CAM-32 subset: CAM-33 PWA audit, CAM-34 storage adapters, CAM-35 monorepo scaffold, CAM-36 packages/game, CAM-37 packages/client.
Defer CAM-38+ Capacitor/Expo shells until web product shape stable.

## Library lock-in (from priority doc)
Prefer: zustand persist, zod WS validation, lucide chrome, thin theme/sound/storage adapters.
Careful: next-themes+cookies-next (already adopted — keep thin API for native), framer-motion juice, Web Audio behind adapter, react-joyride (DOM-only).
CAM-88: use Workers-compatible gateway key, OpenAI-compatible HTTP, swappable provider.

## Path contention notes
- `party/cambio.ts`: CAM-88 (env wiring) then CAM-19 (major refactor) — sequence strictly
- `src/hooks/useGameConnection.ts`: CAM-20 after CAM-19 stable
- `src/game/bot-chat-llm.ts`: CAM-88 only in phase 1
- Home/lobby UI: matchmaking before tutorial

## Conventions
- Linear IDs CAM-n; branch `evanbrierton/cam-<n>-<slug>` for issue work; orchestrate branches `orch/project-priority/<task>`
- Mark Linear In Progress when coding; In Review when draft PR open
- Quality gate: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`
- openPR workers: draft PR base `main` via ManagePullRequest tool
acceptance: docs/orchestrate/project-priority-discovery.md exists with all 5 phases, issue IDs, path contention, and defer list
Handoff includes brief content for dependsOn consumers
No product code changes
